objective: test whether DDP effective global batch 16 improves the cached-native v123 e5/d4 recipe compared with exp007 DDP global batch 4

initialization.load_policy: load public model weights directly; do not initialize from exp006, exp007, or other fine-tuned checkpoints
initialization.optimizer_resume: resume only between exp014 DDP segments

preprocessing.normalization: orientation fix, crop-to-nonzero, full cropped-volume z-score once, then native-resolution patch/window sampling

schedule.prompt_policy: multi-finding 2 positive + 1 negative; one-finding 1 positive + 2 negatives; every selected positive nonempty in its sampled patch

training.augmentation: none added beyond VoxTell patch sampling
training.ddp_accumulation_sync_policy: defer DDP all-reduce with no_sync on non-final accumulation microsteps

validation.eval_policy: training pauses at each segment; val200 inference is sharded over all four GPUs; fixed JSON is passed directly

comparison_plan.primary_baseline: exp007 DDP global batch 4 epoch100 val200
comparison_plan.sample_matched_checkpoint: relative to exp007 batch4 only: exp014 epoch25 val200 versus exp007 epoch100 val200; both consume 40000 patch events, while exp014 epoch25 is 4x a batch1 run at the same 2500 updates
comparison_plan.update_matched_checkpoint: relative to exp007 batch4: exp014 epoch100 val200 versus exp007 epoch100 val200; both use 10000 optimizer updates, while exp014 consumes 160000 patch events = 4x exp007 batch4 and 16x batch1 at the same update count

differences_from_exp007: Increase effective global batch size from 4 to 16 using local batch 1, DDP world size 4, and gradient accumulation 4.
Use a 160000-event materialized schedule consumed rank-wise across 10000 optimizer updates.
Use DDP no_sync during non-final accumulation microsteps.
Prefer latest valid rolling checkpoint for mid-segment resume, falling back to the previous barrier checkpoint.
Do not change preprocessing, initialization, architecture, loss, optimizer family, or LR values.
